verdict.rationale: Earth Class Mail documents opening and scanning mail contents in facilities it operates, beyond envelope images, and offers high-resolution scans, AI summaries and paid expedited scanning. The evidence never states searchable PDF output or OCR, and never gives a same-day or next-business-day turnaround commitment; expedited scanning is priced but has no stated time. Missing for 10: explicit searchable-PDF/OCR output, a stated scan turnaround SLA, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an operator, my mail is opened and scanned to searchable PDFs with a stated turnaround — same or next business day — not just an envelope photo

citations.quote: opening and scanning completed in facilities we operate with access controls
